en:
Control

Introduction

Control includes functions for timing, program flow, conditional logic, and project termination. These controls let you pause execution, create loops, define logic paths, and end a program.

Functions and Keywords

Below is a list of available controls, including API functions and C++ keywords:

  • wait – Pauses the project for a set amount of time.
  • for – Repeats a block of code a set number of times.
  • if – Runs a block of code if a condition is true.
  • if/else – Runs one block of code if a condition is true, or a different block if it is false.
  • if/else if/else – Checks multiple conditions in order and runs the first block whose condition is true.
  • while – Repeats a block of code while a condition remains true.
  • break – Exits the current loop immediately.
  • programStop – Ends the project immediately.

wait

Pauses the project for a specific amount of time before moving to the next line of code.

Available Functions

void wait(
  double time,
  timeUnits units );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
time double The amount of time to wait, as a positive double.
units timeUnits The unit to represent the time: msec (default) – Milliseconds or seconds

Return Values

This function does not return a value.

Examples

// Stop driving after 1 second
Drivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(1, seconds);
Drivetrain.stop();

for

Repeats a block of code. The counting form runs a set number of times; the range-based form runs once for each item in a collection.

Syntax

1 — Counting loop — runs a fixed number of times.

for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   // code block
}

2 — Range-based loop — runs once for each item in a collection.

for (type element : collection) {
   // code block
}

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
count int The number of times that the code block will be repeated.
type Type Name The data type of each item in the collection (e.g. int, double).
element variable The name of the variable to hold the value of the current item of the loop.
collection array The Array (or vector) that holds the items that will be looped through.

Return Values

This control structure does not return a value.

Examples

// Drive in a square
for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  Drivetrain.driveFor(forward, 100, mm);
  Drivetrain.turnFor(right, 90, degrees);
}

// Drive forward different distances
int distances[] = {100, 150, 200};
for (int d : distances) {
  Drivetrain.driveFor(forward, d, mm);
  wait(0.5, seconds);
}

if

Runs the enclosed block of code if the condition is true.

Syntax

if (condition) {
  // code block
}

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
condition bool An expression or variable that is evaluated when the statement runs. If it is true, the code inside the if block runs; if it is false, the block is skipped.

Return Values

This control structure does not return a value.

Examples

while (true) {
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    // Display a message once the screen is pressed
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
    Brain.Screen.setCursor(1, 1);
    Brain.Screen.print("Screen pressed!");
    break;
  }
  wait(5, msec);
}

(if-else)=

if/else

Determines which enclosed block of code runs based on whether the condition is true or false.

Syntax

if (condition) {
  // code block if true
}
else {
  // code block if false
}

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
condition bool An expression or variable that is evaluated when the statement runs. If it is true, the code inside the if block runs; if it is false, the code inside the else block runs instead.

Return Values

This control structure does not return a value.

Examples

while (true) {
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    // Turn the screen green when pressed
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  } else {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
  }
}

if/else if/else

Selects which enclosed block of code runs based on multiple conditions.

Syntax

if (condition) {
  // code block if first condition is true
}
else if (condition) {
  // code block if second condition is true
}
else {
  // code block if no conditions are true
}

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
condition bool An expression or variable that is evaluated when the statement runs. The first condition that is true determines which block runs; if none are true, the else block runs.

Return Values

This control structure does not return a value.

Notes

  • if runs its block if the condition is true.

  • else if checks additional conditions only if all previous conditions are false. Multiple else if statements can be used.

  • else runs its block only if none of the previous conditions are true.

    Examples

while (true) {
  // Turn screen blue if pressed on the left half
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing() && Brain.Screen.xPosition() < 240) {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(blue);

  // Turn screen green if pressed on the right half
  } else if (Brain.Screen.pressing() && Brain.Screen.xPosition() > 240) {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);

  } else {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
  }

  wait(20, msec);
}

while

Repeatedly runs code as long as the condition is true.

Syntax

while (condition) {
  // code block
}

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
condition bool An expression or variable that is evaluated before each iteration. If it is true, the loop continues; if it is false, the loop stops.

Return Values

This control structure does not return a value.

Notes

  • It can also be used like a "Wait until" by adding ! before the condition, as shown in the examples below.

    Examples

while (true) {
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    // Turn the screen green whenever it's pressed
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  } else {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
  }
}

// Wait until the screen is pressed to turn it green
while (!Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
  wait(20, msec);
}

Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);

break

Exits the current loop immediately. If in a nested loop, break exits the innermost loop.

Syntax

break;

Parameters

This statement does not accept any parameters.

Return Values

This statement does not return a value.

Examples

while (true) {

  // Press the screen to pause on a color
  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(red);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    break;
  }

  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    break;
  }
}

programStop

Ends a project immediately.

Syntax

Brain.programStop();

Parameters

This statement does not accept any parameters.

Return Values

This statement does not return a value.

Examples

while (true) {

  // Press the screen to end the project
  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(red);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    Brain.programStop();
  }

  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    Brain.programStop();
  }
}
zh:
流程控制

概述

控制包括定时、程序流程、条件逻辑和项目终止的功能。这些控件允许您暂停执行、创建循环、定义逻辑路径和结束程序。

函数与关键字

下面是可用控件的列表，包括 API 函数和 C++ 关键字：

  • wait– 将项目暂停一段设定的时间。
  • for– 将代码块重复设定的次数。
  • if– 如果条件为真则运行代码块。
  • if/else– 如果条件为真，则运行一个代码块；如果条件为假，则运行不同的代码块。
  • if/else if/else– 按顺序检查多个条件并运行条件为 true 的第一个块。
  • while– 在条件保持为真时重复代码块。
  • break– 立即退出当前循环。
  • programStop– 立即结束项目。

wait

在移动到下一行代码之前将项目暂停特定的时间。

函数重载

void wait(
  double time,
  timeUnits units );

参数

参数 类型 说明
time double 等待的时间量，为正值double。
units timeUnits 表示时间的单位：msec（默认）-毫秒或seconds

返回值

此函数无返回值。

示例

// Stop driving after 1 second
Drivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(1, seconds);
Drivetrain.stop();

for

重复一段代码。计数表运行设定的次数；基于范围的表单针对集合中的每个项目运行一次。

语法

1—计数循环 — 运行固定次数。

for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   // code block
}

2—基于范围的循环 — 对集合中的每个项目运行一次。

for (type element : collection) {
   // code block
}

参数

参数 类型 说明
count int 代码块重复的次数。
type 类型名称 集合中每个项目的数据类型（例如int、double）。
element variable 用于保存循环当前项值的变量名称。
collection array 保存将循环遍历的项目的数组（或向量）。

返回值

此控制结构无返回值。

示例

// Drive in a square
for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  Drivetrain.driveFor(forward, 100, mm);
  Drivetrain.turnFor(right, 90, degrees);
}

// Drive forward different distances
int distances[] = {100, 150, 200};
for (int d : distances) {
  Drivetrain.driveFor(forward, d, mm);
  wait(0.5, seconds);
}

if

如果条件为true，则运行随附的代码块。

语法

if (condition) {
  // code block
}

参数

参数 类型 说明
condition bool 语句运行时计算的表达式或变量。如果是true，则运行if块内的代码；如果是false，则跳过该块。

返回值

此控制结构无返回值。

示例

while (true) {
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    // Display a message once the screen is pressed
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
    Brain.Screen.setCursor(1, 1);
    Brain.Screen.print("Screen pressed!");
    break;
  }
  wait(5, msec);
}

(如果-否则)=

if/else

根据条件是true还是false确定运行哪个封闭的代码块。

语法

if (condition) {
  // code block if true
}
else {
  // code block if false
}

参数

参数 类型 说明
condition bool 语句运行时计算的表达式或变量。如果是true，则运行if块内的代码；如果是false，则运行else块内的代码。

返回值

此控制结构无返回值。

示例

while (true) {
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    // Turn the screen green when pressed
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  } else {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
  }
}

如果/否则如果/否则

根据多个条件选择运行哪个封闭的代码块。

语法

if (condition) {
  // code block if first condition is true
}
else if (condition) {
  // code block if second condition is true
}
else {
  // code block if no conditions are true
}

参数

参数 类型 说明
condition bool 语句运行时计算的表达式或变量。第一个条件true决定哪个块运行；如果没有true，则运行else块。

返回值

此控制结构无返回值。

说明与注意事项

  • 如果条件为true，则

    if运行其块。

  • else if仅当所有先前条件均为false时才检查附加条件。可以使用多个else if语句。

  • 仅当前面的条件都不满足true时，

    else才会运行其块。

    示例

while (true) {
  // Turn screen blue if pressed on the left half
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing() && Brain.Screen.xPosition() < 240) {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(blue);

  // Turn screen green if pressed on the right half
  } else if (Brain.Screen.pressing() && Brain.Screen.xPosition() > 240) {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);

  } else {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
  }

  wait(20, msec);
}

while

只要条件为true，就重复运行代码。

语法

while (condition) {
  // code block
}

参数

参数 类型 说明
condition bool 每次迭代之前计算的表达式或变量。如果是true，则继续循环；如果是false，则循环停止。

返回值

此控制结构无返回值。

说明与注意事项

  • 也可以通过在条件前添加!来像“等到”一样使用，如下面的示例所示。

    示例

while (true) {
  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    // Turn the screen green whenever it's pressed
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  } else {
    Brain.Screen.clearScreen();
  }
}

// Wait until the screen is pressed to turn it green
while (!Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
  wait(20, msec);
}

Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);

break

立即退出当前循环。如果在嵌套循环中，break退出最内层循环。

语法

break;

参数

该语句不接受任何参数。

返回值

该语句不返回值。

示例

while (true) {

  // Press the screen to pause on a color
  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(red);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    break;
  }

  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    break;
  }
}

programStop

立即结束项目。

语法

Brain.programStop();

参数

该语句不接受任何参数。

返回值

该语句不返回值。

示例

while (true) {

  // Press the screen to end the project
  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(red);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    Brain.programStop();
  }

  Brain.Screen.clearScreen(green);
  wait(500, msec);

  if (Brain.Screen.pressing()) {
    Brain.programStop();
  }
}
